brief.ask: Create the brand family for Lumenfold, the office suite in this monorepo: the Lumenfold master brand and product icons for Lumenfold Docs, Sheets and Sign.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: privacy-first and European, calm and precise. The three product icons must clearly belong to one family and still be told apart at small sizes. Web apps only.

claim.notes: All three directions (crease, lightcut, threshold) got 'none' from the critic in two sketch-review rounds, so no concept was developed, finalized or exported.

concepts.title: Crease
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 split diamond/kite, a cut shape; s6 two thin spikes, M/Y or rabbit ears, dies at 16 px; s7 fragmented bird/shards, docs reads as a 7, sign as S/Z, not calm. Family belongs in s5 only and its docs/sheets differ only by seam direction. Try a move that is not a cut: one solid silhouette whose fold is an overlap or tonal turn, not a gap.

concepts.title: Light cuts
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s4 slanted bars over an underline, like !! or a typographic H/i, members barely differ at 16 px; s5 split diamond, left-pointing play/back arrow; s6 table lamp or traffic cone on a plinth, a literal light cliché, and the family adds only a bar or a split. Try light as a single owned silhouette (not bars, cones or windows) that carries all three members by one added element.

concepts.title: Threshold
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 door or horseshoe magnet, sign adds a bell; s2 split arched door, sheets/sign muddled; s3 rainbow or wifi arches, sheets unreadable at 16 px; s4/s5 split half-disc and split diamond, DocuSign/yin-yang-like cuts; s6 sliced disc, burger or dial. Nothing passes distinctiveness 7. Try a different move than the seam/split/arch: one bold ownable silhouette, members differing by a single internal mark.
